preservedResponsibilities: AQF9AG ports the original timezone.cpp host detection decision body and default-zone once/adopt/copy lifecycle. Empty-name failure, short-name raw-offset mismatch rejection, fixed-zone fallback, Unknown clone and ordered platform hooks are preserved. Browser platform hooks remain an explicit separate adaptation. The unchanged timezone.cpp/olsontz.cpp and ICU78.3 libraries/data match 310 native cases, including 144 injected host captures, default initialization/adoption and 160 Calendar ownership/cache cases. Locale forLocaleOrDefault, calendar constructors, native allocator/mutex/cleanup/ABI and undefined ownership inputs remain uncertified.
omittedResponsibilities: Only the stated consumed source responsibilities are ported. Complete services and native allocation/concurrency/lifetime/ABI/undefined inputs remain uncertified.

filenameDivergence.rationale: Original implementation is split by responsibility to retain the repository file-size budget and synchronous source ownership/dispatch without base/concrete class evaluation cycles. Shared fragments operate directly on the one actual owner.
